notes:
PDF to Word, and six things it was getting wrong.

A scanned page came out at three-quarters of the sheet, with the text read from it landing beside the picture of itself - and two scanned pages became three, with a blank one between them. A scan also made the document eight times the size of the PDF; a 523 KB form now converts to 533 KB instead of 4.5 MB.

In tables: half a header came out black, and two-column rows collapsed into a single line with the right column slid across the page. Both are fixed, along with the header row of the same table, which turned out to need a different fix again.

Every one of these was found by converting a real document and measuring the result against the page it came from.
